$comment: Device-spike gates (11-platform.md 4.3). webgpu.mobile flips to true only after the M01c iPhone run passes (30 min, no abnormal exit, p90 inside budget); see docs/device-spike/M01c-report.md. World switches (M02b1, DL-698): world.cards and world.massing are build-time keys read like webgpu.mobile, never from BootConfig.flags (C12 FeatureFlag is a closed union without world.* members); a remote downgrade goes through the governor knobs only. M02b2: world.rain (default true) switches the rain streaks and overlay; world.atmosphere (default false, the takram adapter of M10d2) is read by the sky and changes nothing until that adapter lands.
